_comment: User stories told as roles declared in smart-base/scenarios/roles.json (bean 4nfs).
name: smart-base

stories.want: Read each proposed L1 exclusion in place on the printed page before signing it
stories.soThat: no normative WHO recommendation, implementation practice or remark is silently dropped from downstream DAKs

stories.want: Reject a proposed exclusion with a recorded reason when the sentence states a normative practice or recommendation
stories.soThat: the authoring agent re-curates the sentence as an L1 node and coverage reflects only verified exclusions
